logline: 창밖에서 그림자를 잃어버린 소년이 나타나, 아이들을 데리고 밤하늘로 날아오른다.
destination: 두 번째 별 너머의 섬 — 어른이 없는 곳
protagonist: 나뭇잎을 엮어 입은 열두 살 남짓의 소년
anchor: a boy of about twelve in a tunic of stitched leaves, tousled reddish hair, bare feet
palette: night indigo, nursery cream, warm amber, star silver, deep window blue

pan.label: 소년
pan.desc: a boy of about twelve in a tunic of stitched leaves, tousled reddish hair, bare feet, a small belt pouch

wendy.label: 맏이 소녀
wendy.desc: a girl of about thirteen in a long white nightgown, dark hair in a loose braid, bare feet

nursery.label: 아이 방
nursery.desc: a Victorian nursery with three small beds, a tall sash window, a nightlight burning low

rooftops.label: 런던 지붕 위
rooftops.desc: chimney pots and slate rooftops under a starry night sky, a river bend far below

beats.beat: 밤중에 아이 방 창문이 저절로 열린다.
beats.visual: a tall sash window swinging open by itself in a dark Victorian nursery, curtains blowing in
beats.motion: the window swings inward, curtains billow into the room, the nightlight gutters

beats.beat: 소년이 마루에서 제 그림자를 붙잡으려 한다.
beats.visual: a leaf-clad boy grabbing at a shadow sliding across a nursery floor, beds behind him
beats.motion: the shadow slips away across the boards, he lunges after it, dust lifts

beats.visual: a girl in a nightgown stitching a shadow to a seated boy's bare heel by lamplight
beats.motion: the needle draws through, the shadow settles at his heel, lamplight sways

beats.beat: 소년이 소녀의 손을 잡고 바닥에서 뜬다.
beats.visual: a leaf-clad boy and a girl in a nightgown rising a foot above a nursery floor, hands joined
beats.motion: they lift upward off the floor, her nightgown hem drifts, the curtains rise with them

beats.visual: two children flying above slate rooftops and chimney pots under a starry sky
beats.motion: they climb upward over the roofs, smoke streams past them, stars wheel overhead

beats.visual: a leaf-clad boy hanging in the night sky pointing toward one bright star, city lights below
beats.motion: his arm swings up toward the star, his tunic flutters, cloud streams past below

beats.visual: an open nursery window seen from outside, curtains streaming out into the night, room empty
beats.motion: the curtains stream outward into the dark, the nightlight fades, frost creeps in

beats.beat: 빈 아이 방 마루에 바늘 하나가 놓여 있다.
beats.visual: a single needle and a length of thread on an empty nursery floor, three beds unmade
beats.motion: the thread stirs in the draught, dust turns in the moonlight, a bed sheet lifts

withheld: 그 섬에서 기다리는 것과, 아이들이 돌아오게 되는 사연
